body.name: delayed-order compound-Poisson handle
body.construction: For a prescribed \(r\), start from strictly positive compound-Poisson jump intensities on \(\{1,\ldots,r\}\) and perturb the spare environment by signed intensity changes \(\varepsilon(-1)^{r-j}{r\choose j}\) at jump \(j\), with \(\varepsilon\) smaller than the baseline intensity margin; combine this with the exact source swap \(S\).
